host_logits_stride.method: get_logits_ith uses output_reorder then output_resolve_row and logits.data + row * model.vocab.n_tokens; all crossed returned rows saved and independently validated
host_logits_stride.proof_level: source-bound host output layout, not backend operand/dispatch

logits_mask: Actual batch logits_requested captured; all B common rows true and same across four cells. Attention causal_attn=1 in real logs; physical backend attention-mask tensors/operand strides/dispatch not directly measured.
KV_layout: Independent state parser validates F16 keys and transposed F16 values, exact serialized row/element byte counts, layer counts, logical positions and single-sequence ownership. Serialized layout is not proof of a unique execution kernel.
reservation_scope: Real current complete recipes: N1 outputs3/perseq3 UB1; E outputs2/perseq2 UB2; /72 both current recipes outputs3/perseq3 UB1. Candidate and ordinary R outputs512/perseq1, private candidate phase128-to1 in one target context.
